ops.title: cc-guides reconcile push broken since 2da9cee (exact-commit checkout)
ops.description:
yasyf/cc-guides@2da9cee ("ci: checkout exact guides commit", 2026-07-25T06:01Z) changed both checkout steps in the reusable guides.yml to `ref: ${{ inputs.commit || github.sha }}`, producing a detached-HEAD checkout. The render step still works, but the reconcile push now fails persistently: "push rejected (attempt N) — refetching" x3 within ~2s, then "could not land the re-render after 3 attempts" — with no competing commit on main. The refetch loop cannot help because the local ref being pushed never advances under detached HEAD.

Evidence:
- Guides run 30151118370 on cc-skills@eae5af0 (routing-table edit): render clean 3x, push rejected 3x, failed. Rerun failed identically.
- Last successful reconcile push: a67dede at 2026-07-25T01:46Z (for cc-skills@e9db7c6) — pre-2da9cee.
- The 06:12Z Guides success on c84b090 had no drift, so it never exercised the push path.
- No branch protection on main; only ruleset is tag-scoped ("Immutable v* release tags").

Impact: every consumer repo's next drift-carrying render fails — cc-skills root CLAUDE.md (and the fleet's) stays stale on the pre-Opus-5 routing table until fixed. The canonical plugin/guides/md/claude-rules.md on cc-skills main is already correct; once cc-guides pushes work again, the daily 17 9 * * * cron heals all consumers with no further action.

Fix lives in yasyf/cc-guides: make the reconcile push detached-HEAD-aware (e.g. push HEAD:main with a fast-forward guard, or recreate the branch ref at the exact commit before rendering) without losing 2da9cee's exact-commit verification intent.

ops.text: cc-guides reconcile push succeeds from a detached exact-commit checkout (guides.yml@main)
cc-skills Guides workflow green on a drift-carrying commit; root CLAUDE.md re-rendered with the Opus 5 routing table
